update.body: The bundled manifest changed since you installed (likely an upstream rename). Re-write .mcp.json with the canonical entry — surgical, only the plugin's owned keys are touched.

headroom.title: Headroom AI
headroom.dialogDescription: Manage the global Headroom installation and provider routing.
headroom.panelDescription: Installed globally, activated independently for Codex and Claude.
headroom.confirmDetach: This disables Specrails routing and stops the proxy. The existing system Headroom install is left untouched.
headroom.confirmUninstall: This disables Codex and Claude routes, stops the proxy, and removes the Specrails-managed Headroom tool.

provider.noProjectUsesProvider: No Specrails project uses this provider

uv_missing_or_corrupt.title: Bundled uv is not available
uv_missing_or_corrupt.guidance: Specrails could not start its bundled uv runtime. Reinstall Specrails or use Repair once the runtime is available.

network_unavailable.title: Headroom could not be downloaded
network_unavailable.guidance: Check your network connection and retry. Specrails will keep the install isolated in its own tool directory.

package_resolution_failed.title: Headroom dependencies could not be resolved
package_resolution_failed.guidance: Retry the install. If it keeps failing, open diagnostics and share the uv output.

install_permission_failed.title: Specrails cannot write its tool directory
install_permission_failed.guidance: Check permissions under ~/.specrails/tools, then retry the install.

headroom_not_found_after_install.title: Install finished but Headroom was not found
headroom_not_found_after_install.guidance: Run Repair install. Specrails will reinstall Headroom and verify the executable.

learning_setup_failed.title: Headroom learning could not be enabled
learning_setup_failed.guidance: Headroom is installed, but output-savings calibration did not finish. Keep using proxy routing while metrics collect output samples.

metrics_unavailable.title: Headroom metrics are not available yet
metrics_unavailable.guidance: Start routing traffic through Headroom. Specrails will refresh token-savings metrics as soon as the proxy reports samples.

proxy_port_busy.title: Headroom proxy port is already in use
proxy_port_busy.guidance: Choose another port or stop the process using the current port, then retry activation.

proxy_unhealthy.title: Headroom proxy did not become healthy
proxy_unhealthy.guidance: Retry activation. If it repeats, open diagnostics to inspect the proxy output.

provider_route_failed.title: Provider route verification failed
provider_route_failed.guidance: Specrails could not verify the provider route. The provider remains inactive; retry after checking diagnostics.

provider_config_conflict.title: Existing provider configuration conflicts with Headroom
provider_config_conflict.guidance: Review diagnostics before enabling system-wide activation. Specrails-managed routing remains reversible.

activation_partially_applied.title: Activation was only partially applied
activation_partially_applied.guidance: Specrails attempted rollback. Review diagnostics and retry the affected provider.

not_installed.title: Headroom is not installed
not_installed.guidance: Install Headroom first, then activate Codex or Claude.

uninstall_failed.title: Headroom could not be uninstalled
uninstall_failed.guidance: Specrails disabled Headroom routing but could not remove the managed tool. Open diagnostics, then retry uninstall.

unknown.title: Headroom operation failed
unknown.guidance: Retry the operation. If it repeats, open diagnostics and share the details.

projectWizard.description: Select the project where this project-scoped plugin should be configured.

serena.description: Installs project-local MCP configuration and plugin state. Other projects are untouched.

diagnostics.title: Headroom diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Technical status for the Specrails-managed Headroom installation and proxy.
